lines.text: Our work won't take too long. I hope we're not disrupting the cleanup.
Of course not! However, we still have some Blight nearby.
Sure. Guess I'll tag along as well and try to be helpful.
Of course not! In fact, most of the Blight masses nearby have been cleared.
Let me tag along. I'll see if I can be helpful.
I'm right here, Mi Fu.
Endmin? Why are you here? I'm still monitoring the Blight cleanup at the monitoring center.
The boss is coming too? Don't see her anywhere.

options: I can clean them up along the way.
We'll take care of that as well.
Tianshi Zhuang and I are getting some data from here.

r: Tianshi Zhuang and I are getting some data from here.
I can clean them up along the way.
We'll take care of that as well.

scenes.summary: After viewing the Blight Tide data, you and Zhuang quickly come up with a way to improve the Xiranite Nexus. However, given the risks of the experiment, you decide to carry out the test at an empty islet known as Qijian Dais.

lines.text: What of it, boss? Hope the instruments aren't damaged.
No. The data stored within is intact as well.
...Analysis of the data looks rather promising.
A little bold ... but worth a try... This solution will further reduce Xiranite consumption!
Mi Fu ... did you see something that won't work?
No. I don't know science.
Gotta work on something. I'll leave you two to your wild brainstorming.
Nothing... Just thinking about the past, how the Science Station people used to discuss questions. Like what we're doing now...
Yes... Every idea was bolder than the last. We got more intense with every discussion.
When I first heard their argument, I thought they were fighting.
No. I was young when I joined the Science Station. It wasn't my place to talk.
But, listening in the discussions taught me a lot. I learned a great deal as I sorted files for my peers.
They didn't simply like me. They took care of me.
Perhaps I was.
Now that we have a working idea, why don't we use the Xiranite Nexus for a field test?
The test is risky. Let me think... ⟦key|Qijian Dais⟧ is an islet outside the city. It's pretty much empty. What do you say?
It's just the first time I saw someone keeping pace with you. People once told me your ideas are too wild and impossible.
Oh, nobody told me that before...
No need to overthink it. It's great we got someone who thinks like you for once.

options: Why are you quiet? And why are you smiling?
Are you ... trying to say something?
Science Station people...?
Discussed?
Have you "argued" with other people?
The Science Station crew definitely liked you.
Hardworking, helpful, and diligent. You must be popular.

scenes.summary: After cleaning up the beasts along the way, you meet Lifeng at Qijian Dais offering respects to his late parents. He tells you that his parents died in the accident ten years ago. Zhuang ponders silently as you speak with Lifeng.

lines.text: Is there anything I can do to help?
Could you guard the raft station and tell people to stay away?
Much appreciated. So ... are you here for the sword Tianshi Li left behind?
When I was a kid, my mom and dad would bring me here for training. Once the battle was over, I wanted to come and pay my respects.
But upon arrival, I didn't get a chance to say anything before the beasts pounced at me.
I know you're on urgent business, but can you give me a while... Just a short while to say a few words.
Mom... Dad...
This crisis taught me something. You were more than my parents. You performed your duty.
As Tianshi, it was not only I who needed you, but also many others. Yet, I was just a clingy kid ... who always wished you could be by my side at all times.
Sorry... I was really selfish back then.
Ahem. Well, that's it from me...
It's only natural for children to miss their parents.
You knew they wouldn't reply, yet you kept your message to heart. Always remembering, and never forgetting...
That is definitely not selfish.
Thank you ... Endmin.
I, uh, I shouldn't get in the way of your test. No worries. I'll make sure nobody barges into the place.
Yes. It's a dangerous test and we need an uninhabited area. This islet is the best option available.
Endmin? Tianshi Zhuang...? Why are you on the islet as well?
I thought I cleaned up all the beasts along the way. Turned out I missed a few.
Of course!
Thanks a mil.
I guess so ... but not really.

options: We're here to run a test.
You weren't being selfish.

scenes.summary: You successfully improve upon the Xiranite Nexus together with Zhuang. You are about to go to the underground array to seal the rift when Perlica suddenly contacts you.

lines.text: ...Careful.
Hngh...
Don't worry. I got it.
Sure ... I'm ready.
Is it alright?
But... I'm still a little...
We can begin, Endmin.
He always wanted to be here. When the opportunity came, he took it without hesitation.
When Tianshi Li and his wife were around, they'd invite me too. Lifeng barely reached my knees back then. Time really flew past me. The kid's a big boy now.
Yes. He's just a teen, but he knows far more about duty than many adults.
He takes after his parents... Dutiful, selfless, and utterly without fear.

options: Can we increase the power output further?
Good. We can seal the portal. Let us begin.
Did we succeed?
How did it go? Are you alright?
Didn't expect to run into Lifeng here...
And an understanding, helpful one at that.

scenes.summary: Mi Fu calls right after Perlica ends her radio communication. She asks Zhuang to take a look at the injured personnel who are now waking up. The plan is disrupted. Both you and Zhuang have urgent work to tend to. You agree to rendezvous at the Xiranite Central Laboratory.

lines.text: The reports show that it's not that urgent yet. We should head to the Bureau of Swordmancers while there's still time.
No, it's from Mi Fu. She told me that ... our injured are coming around.
I have to see them.
Alright... Once you're done, meet me at the Central Laboratory...
Okay... See you later.
The rift is in the city. If the defense system upgrade fails ... or encounters an error, and if the rift could not be closed, the outcomes would be devastating.
Before I go, we'll need to do some preliminary datalogging.
But...
It's alright. Leave it to me.
Endmin, we should get there ASAP.

options: A message from a Tianshi of the Bureau of Swordmancers?
You received the news too?
Don't worry. Tend to your wounded. I'll solve the technical issue.
You should. They need you. I'll take care of the defense system.
Sure. I'll see you there.
What about the underground rift...?

scenes.summary: You arrive at the Bureau of Swordmancers and spend quite a bit of time helping the Tianshi solve the technical issues. You also have to turn down the Tianshi's invitation before rushing to the Xiranite Central Laboratory to find Zhuang Fangyi.

lines.text: It's the Endmin!
So sorry about this. It happened during deployment. We don't know why, but we're getting error messages.
The engineering module ... something might be wrong with it. I've got my colleagues to help.
Endmin, the torque transmission module that reported the error is giving off strange grinding noises.
But ... we couldn't simply fix it because Endfield tech differs from that in Wuling, and we don't want to break anything.
Never thought we could do that... Interesting.
This energy feedback system... I think I can use it in my own project.
Well, it's working as intended.
Endmin, if you have time, would you mind staying for a bit?
We got so many questions to ask you.
(That took me quite a while. Gotta hurry to the lab... Tianshi Zhuang should be there already.)
(I hope I didn't keep her waiting for too long.)
Tianshi Zhuang's work does take top priority. Don't let us keep you, Endmin. We'll take care of the rest.

options: Don't worry. Let me take a look.
Done. It should be working now.
So, no more problems, I hope.
Sorry. I got to meet up with Tianshi Zhuang.
Maybe next time. I can't keep Tianshi Zhuang waiting.

lines.text: Endmin, how was that test you performed with Tianshi Zhuang? I heard something really loud ... it got me worried.
If you never told me to stay put, I would've rushed in at once.
That's great...
Tianshi Zhuang hardly asks anyone to assist her work.
It's just ... that area's not really my specialty. I couldn't help even if I wanted to.
But we're so lucky to have you around, Endmin. Thanks a lot for helping her.
Tianshi Zhuang has taken care of me for years... It's the least I could do.
Since the test is over, I think I should get going. See you later.

options: Both of us are actually pleased with the results.
Why thank me? She's the one getting my help.
Why, thank you too for keeping people away.

r: Both of us are actually pleased with the results.
Why thank me? She's the one getting my help.
Why, thank you too for keeping people away.

lines.text: Endmin... I'll see you later.
